subject: BUG-259: offline, a forged admin flag can NEVER be revoked, because the async verifier returns null and the contract is 'keep showing'
description: Found by Mallory during the HEXOS-6 vote, by source trace (she had no browser this session, so treat runtime behaviour as strongly-supported-by-code rather than observed). AccessGuard.js:174-176 isFirebaseAdmin() is a bare synchronous localStorage read. require('admin') calls showContent() immediately, then _scheduleAsyncVerification('admin') hits a Cloud Function to catch forgery. Its own comment at :305-312 states the contract: result true = keep showing, result null = inconclusive (offline/not signed in) = KEEP SHOWING. _verifyAdminAsync returns null on any network failure. ONLINE this is a transient trust-then-verify window that closes in under a second. OFFLINE the verification can never resolve either way, so it is permanently null and the forgery is permanent and unrevocable. Four pages are affected: _app/path-view.html, _app/admin/observatory.html, _app/houses/security-plus-crypto/index.html, _app/workshop/index.html. This is dormant today because there is no offline mode. HEXOS-6 would ACTIVATE it, which is a concrete example of the scope-the-blast-radius lesson: a correct change (shipping an offline-capable image) is the EVENT that fires a dormant defect. Must be fixed BEFORE any offline capability ships, not after. Fix direction: offline/inconclusive should fail CLOSED for admin specifically, or admin-gated pages should not be present in an offline image at all.
